messages:
Aisha (Docs): FYI i'm assembling a small "FAQ + examples" PR for the new tiered-credit semantics (downgrades, burst credits, header names). plan: <1 paragraph FAQ, three tiny SDK snippets, a short express middleware, and a PromQL grafana example. aiming to push before lunch.

Tom (DevEx): nice. can you show how the headers map to the console? devs often ask what X-Redwood-Quota-* vs the console numbers mean.

Aisha (Docs): will add a one-liner: Console -> Usage analytics shows consumed vs remaining per-route; headers are a real-time per-request snapshot. i'll link the console panel.

Ravi (Eng): note: header names in prod are X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining and X-Redwood-Quota-Window. we keep X-Quota-* for backwards compatibility. docs should prefer the Red wood-prefixed names and show a tiny fallback parse.

Aisha (Docs): can you paste a minimal express middleware i can include?

Ravi (Eng): sure:```js
// attach quota info from response headers
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const rem = res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') || res.getHeader('X-Quota-Remaining');
  const win = res.getHeader('X-Redwood-Quota-Window') || res.getHeader('X-Quota-Window');
  req.quota = { remaining: Number(rem || 0), windowSec: Number(win || 0) };
  next();
});
```

Nina (PM): include a short FAQ entry about downgrades mid-cycle: credits are prorated and most customers see a short grace period. link to billing playbook for exact terms.

Priya (Billing): prefer wording: "Typically a short (≈7 day) grace period; enterprise agreements may differ — see billing playbook." avoids hard promises while being helpful.

Aisha (Docs): updated to that phrasing. thanks.

Tom (DevEx): SDK snippets we need: Node fetch wrapper showing header parsing, Python requests example for embeddings usage counts, and a curl one-liner for quick tests. keep each ≤6 lines. also add a one-line tip to use per-route breakdown in Console.

Aisha (Docs): Draft node snippet:```js
// node fetch quick quota check
const res = await fetch(url, { headers });
const rem = Number(res.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') || res.headers.get('X-Quota-Remaining') || 0);
console.log(`remaining tokens: ${rem}`);
```

Aisha (Docs): Draft python snippet:```py
# python requests example for embedding calls
r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print('remaining:', int(r.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining') or 0))
```

Aisha (Docs): curl quick test:```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" $URL | grep -i X-Redwood-Quota
```

Tom (DevEx): perfect. add a 1-line note about burst credits being visible as a separate metric in the dashboard (metric: redwood_burst_credit_balance).

Aisha (Docs): added.

DocsBot: PR checklist reminder: include changelog entry, migration note, and crosslink billing playbook for anything that affects pricing/credits.

Aisha (Docs): adding changelog and a migration section that mentions header name change and telemetry impact. planning to open PR at 1758201500 and request reviews from @Tom (DevEx), @Ravi (Eng), @Priya (Billing).

Ravi (Eng): for the grafana panel, use this PromQL to show token consumption by customer_tier for the past 7 days:```promql
sum by(customer_tier) (increase(redwood_tokens_consumed_total{env="prod", customer_type!~"internal|test"}[7d]))
```
Legend: {{customer_tier}}

Priya (Billing): add a short reconciliation hint: "Use billing exports combined with redwood_tokens_consumed_total for spot-reconciliation; full billing reconciliations are handled via the billing playbook."

Aisha (Docs): included the reconciliation hint and linked the billing export docs.

Tom (DevEx): QA: i'll drop these snippets into the quickstart repo and run a smoke test against staging. i'll flag any tweaks.

Ravi (Eng): i'll validate the PromQL on staging metrics and check the middleware behavior.

Aisha (Docs): thanks all — opening PR later today and will ping reviewers. small doc fixes like this really reduce tickets. :sparkles:
